scoring_justification: Headline quantities are DFT+EPW results that cannot be recomputed in the verifier sandbox; agent-reported values are compared to paper gold with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for elastic constants, Young moduli, and superconducting Tc from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 (elastic constants and Young moduli), Figure 5 and text (Tc 20 K unstrained, 46 K at 13% strain).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Taken directly from paper reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own computed results; verification is against the paper's reference.

outputs.description: Computed four independent in‑plane elastic constants of BL‑δ₆ (2D stiffness coefficients).
Derived in‑plane Young’s moduli along a (armchair) and b (zigzag) directions.
Anisotropic superconducting critical temperatures for unstrained BL‑δ₆ and for 13% tensile strain along the a direction.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the reported values against hidden reference numbers with tolerances appropriate for DFT method spread. Young's modulus Ya is also verified to exceed the graphene reference (346.1 N/m) as a structural check.
